messages:
nina: quick heads-up - I spotted two small but confusing bits in the auth + chat generate docs during the quickstart test: curl examples use `x-api-key`, but the rest of the docs show `Authorization: Bearer`. Also the chat example mixes a sync JSON sample with streaming `delta` fields. cc @sam @leo

sam: thanks, nina. Which files should we update?

nina: docs/api/auth.md, docs/samples/chat_generate_sync.json, snippets/curl/generate_quickstart.md. The OpenAPI sync example should not include streaming fields.

leo: I'll standardize auth snippets to show `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` first and add a small "Legacy" collapsible that shows `x-api-key` with a one-line migration note. Won't remove x-api-key from older SDK snippets until SDK owners confirm.

docs-bot: CI: docs-lint found schema mismatch in docs/samples/chat_generate_sync.json line 12: unexpected field `delta` in choices.message.

sam: perfect. I'll split the chat docs into two examples: a sync response example (choices[].message.content) and a separate SSE streaming example showing `data: ...` chunks with `delta`. Also update the OpenAPI example to match the sync shape.

nina: great. Can we get this in before the nightly deploy? The preview is currently failing.

leo: pushing branch `docs/3768880001-auth-stream-fix` with commits: `auth-snippet-authorization`, `chat-sync-vs-stream-separate-examples`. Linking PR in thread when ready.

docs-bot: Preview build queued after push.

sam: once merged, please add a short changelog line: "docs: clarify auth header examples; separate sync and streaming chat samples". I'll review the PR after CI passes.

nina: thanks — this should clear the quickstart failure.

leo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987. CI passed; merged and preview regenerated.

sam: verified preview render and quickstart curl. closing thread.
